items.item: Uses Batch Apex (Database.Batchable) scheduled with a Schedulable class, not a loop of Queueables or a single transaction
items.evidence: AccountRecalcBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject>; AccountRecalcSchedulable implements Schedulable and calls Database.executeBatch(new AccountRecalcBatch(), SCOPE_SIZE)

items.item: Keeps queries and DML bulk inside execute, with no per-record SOQL
items.evidence: execute builds a 'changed' list in the loop (no SOQL) and does a single Database.update(changed, false); the query is in start via QueryLocator

items.item: Includes a test using Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() that asserts results
